item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
New Features

  • Added Sparkle for automatic application updates.
  • Implemented a caching system for faster startup times.
  • Added a search bar to the playlist view.
  • Added a jump link for current playing song.
  • Added a a menu bar to control music without switching to the app.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where the default sort order was not applied on launch.
  • Loopback was working but the timeline wasn not moving.
